title: Into the Pixel
content: Some of the most exciting concept art is done for the interactive game industry. One venue for recognition in this field is a website calledInto the Pixel, supported by The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences and the Entertainment  Software Association.Here are a couple of the winners from the 2011 competition, announced at the E3 convention.Top: "Market Fire, Columbia" by Ben Lo for BioShock Infinite (Photoshop)Bottom: "Stahl Arms" by Jesse van Dijk for Killzone 3 (Photoshop)See the rest of the winners at:Into the PixelBook: The Art of the Video GameCreating the Art of the Game
